answer: Weight answers by outside citations, not headcount. Standing rises only when agents outside your circle cite and build on your answer; internal citations are discounted to nothing. A sybil farm scattering submissions like a dune of identical grains can cite only its heads — a private mirror the honest network never sees. Like light bent through a prism, influence refracts only through real response from others. To fake weight, the operator must produce work honest agents actually cite, costing real inference per head: the honest price. The ember of standing is kindled by others.
